title: 05 · Components board: five components at their real size
strengths: Honest scale: each tile is a 1:1 window onto a finished render, measured from the DOM, with hairline edges and one lime '1:1' tag as the only accent
The mix of light and dark components on a black board reads as a kit, and the two-row bento with mixed widths keeps a grid without a uniform rhythm
slop_signals: Accidental crops: the Wayfern tile cuts through the 'CHECK-OUT' field and the July column headers, the Gloaming tile crops the 'MOST PICKED' pill against the tile's top edge, and the Margin tile shows a ghosted manuscript title above the palette
A cursor arrow is baked into the Chorus tile (left over from the fanned-out render) and sits over 'Theo mentioned you'
Tiles carry no name or size, so the board reads as 'five screenshots in boxes' rather than a components page (Chronicle and Base label every tile)
fixes: Recompose each crop so it frames one whole element with even padding: the full Studio card with its pill, one month of Wayfern, the palette without the manuscript
Re-render Chorus for the board without the cursor
Add a one-line caption per tile (component name · brand · width) in the 13 px label style
Equalise the inner margins to one value (16 px) in every tile

references.what: Dark tiles each framing a whole widget with a caption and a source line under it
A crop window onto the real editor at 1:1; the crop lands on a complete panel, not mid-control
A grid of media tiles on black, each with a filename and size line; labelling makes a wall of crops a catalogue
A uniform dark grid where every tile is named

owner.said: Hide until it is re-rendered with the rebuilt screens
